Snapshot due, in a scratchpad tree with the HEAD debug binary: run 1 snapshots; run 2 under strace has 1 RDWR open and no new snapshot; with the stamp set to 0, run 3 writes a second snapshot and the stamp reads 1792504862. In run 3's trace, the rename of .terminus-*.db.tmp to the final name (line 148) comes before roll's WAL pwrite64s (lines 150-153). tests/snapshot.rs: 11 passed, including a_snapshot_that_cannot_be_written_is_a_note_and_not_a_failed_pass and a_pass_past_the_interval_takes_the_next_snapshot.

truths.truth: A file that grows between the length check and the tail read is reported up to date with its watermark and block rows unchanged, and the next pass appends it; nothing is appended without its stored hashes (PLAN-1 must-have, D-08).
truths.evidence: ingest/mod.rs:414: when Existing.fetched is None, a complete record past the watermark returns no work, so the hashes are never fetched and nothing is appended. Unit test ingest::tests::a_file_that_grows_after_its_check_is_left_for_the_next_pass (mod.rs:1672) passes in the full suite. It asserts Outcome::UpToDate with the watermark and every block row byte-identical, then that a fresh read commits the record (bytes_read equals the record's length, watermark equals the file length).

truths.truth: Each file's sessions, session_meta and watermarks row is read once at pass start, after recovery, in one LEFT JOIN query that claim and Existing answer from, with no per-file lookup of those tables left (PLAN-2 must-have, D-11; the goal's 'five lookups per file').
truths.evidence: ROWS at ingest/mod.rs:1061 (sessions LEFT JOIN session_meta LEFT JOIN watermarks) and read_rows at :1075. Called after recover::recover and the feedback drain in pass::locked (pass.rs:325), after recovery in backfill::run_with (backfill.rs:136), and for one key on the named path (mod.rs:131). `grep -rn stored_holder crates/terminus-core/src` finds nothing. Outside the test module, SELECTs in ingest/mod.rs are only ROWS, the next-turn read (:1179, grown files only), next_session_no and continues_from. One value traced end to end: transcript_path enters through ROWS, becomes Row.transcript_path, then claim's Holder::of, then Claim::Held, and lands in the walk's failure reason, which an_unchanged_file_whose_key_another_file_holds_is_still_refused asserts names both paths. That test passes at HEAD, as does the LEFT JOIN no-meta case (pass.rs:1238). On the copy, a steady-state pass does 1,605 fstat and 55,163 pread64, against 21,946 and 276,619 at baseline (MEASUREMENT.md).

truths.truth: A grown file's tail is scanned once, not twice, and the watermark is still the byte just past the tail's last newline (PLAN-1 must-have, D-13; the goal's 'triple parse').
truths.evidence: `grep -n scan_from crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/*.rs` returns one call, mod.rs:449, over the stored bytes. The first scan is now `tail.iter().rposition(|b| *b == b'\n').map_or(0, |i| i + 1)` (mod.rs:407), and the watermark is existing.watermark + consumed. That is the same value parse::scan_from computes, since it sets resume = index + 1 at every '\n' (parse/mod.rs:66-87). These pass in the full suite: resuming_from_a_mid_line_watermark_converges_on_a_single_pass, the lean and minimal capture tests (e.g. the_stored_bytes_strictly_decrease_from_full_to_lean_to_minimal, two_runs_over_an_unchanged_lean_transcript_repair_nothing), and backfill.rs. derive_turn keeps its own parse, as D-13 decided.

truths.truth: derive's nine statements go through prepare_cached, and every statement used in one apply loop and one reindex loop fits rusqlite's default cache, so each is compiled once per connection (PLAN-2 must-have, D-14; the goal's 'statements compiled per turn').
truths.evidence: `grep -c prepare_cached crates/terminus-core/src/derive.rs` gives 9, and derive.rs has no tx.execute. The SQL text is unchanged in the diff. Across src, the only other cached statements are archive.rs:86, :205, :279, :301, :313, :329, :362, :388 and recover.rs:461. A walk uses write plus three append_state queries plus derive's 9 (13), and a reindex loop uses layout, numbered_rows and derive's 9 (11). Both fit STATEMENT_CACHE_DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 16 (rusqlite-0.40.2/src/lib.rs:168). store/open.rs is unchanged since 57c036e. Output is unchanged: tests/derive.rs, reindex.rs, index.rs and recall_golden.rs pass against unchanged goldens. The compile count itself was not instrumented; it follows from rusqlite's cache semantics at this statement count.
